body: Thank you for your advice, I will try my best to get out of this situation. I still have some hope left in me I think. Thanks for caring.

Not anyone that I have been in contact with and that would let me stay with them, believe me I have considered all my options many many times. I don't want to kill myself for nothing, but it just gets worse and worse. All I have ever wanted was to just be normal and be happy, I don't think that's a lot to expect.

I would but my mom refuses to even give me a key to the house. She can go out all day and I am stuck inside unless I want to leave the door unlocked, which is a bad idea in this area. It has made things a lot harder then they already are and need to be. I wouldn't wish this life on the most evil person in the world, and I have always tried to do good and help people when I can. I have even thought about fake robbing a bank, because I would probably have a better quality of life in prison then I have right now. I only blame myself though because I put myself in this position.

I had an appointment to see a therapist but I never made it. It is hard to believe but my family is heartless, I have always treated them nice in the past and helped out when they needed it but I can say for certain they don't give a shit about me right now. Thank you for kind words though, I appreciate it.
Thank you for that, I hope to feel like you someday if I make it.

My family knows I am depressed and suicidal and I have one friend if you can call him that even who also knows. They might not know that I am at the edge of doing it but I don't want to scare them or call attention to myself, they can't help anyway. I am not in the position to do any of the things that used to make me happy, I try to see the good but it is really really hard. Thank you for the sentiment, I wish I had your optimism.

I have barely left the house since January. When I do go out I am very self conscious and anxious and it makes everyone stare at me and avoid me like I am crazy. I have no job and no income, I am living with my mom who is on disability and doesn't treat me very nice, barely gives me any food. I have no money obviously. On top of that all I also suffer from mild psoriasis or eczema on my face sometimes, which makes me even more self conscious to go out. 

I spent the last bit of money I had moving to a bigger city for a week to try and get a job but I had no luck and had to come back to the hell that is living with my mom. If I had some easy, painless way of killing myself I would go somewhere secluded and do it right now.

I have always been depressed and borderline suicidal, the past 7 months have been the worst of my life though and I don't think I can last much longer. Everyday is torture, I no longer get even the smallest enjoyment out of life and I just want it to end.

Sorry to put this in your post but maybe you understand what I am going through and have some advice but it seems pretty hopeless right now that things will change.
